name: Trooperoid
source:
Mass produced Chimera solders designed to assault and occupy human towns. With extensive use of machine technology, her body is 80% mechanical. Brutal and ruthless, she derives great joy from oppressing others.

In addition to being able to emit shocks, her right arms is also able to be used as a high powered vacuum. Using it to harvest vast amounts of semen on the tanks on her back, it seems semen collection was another one of her missions in the assaults.

Any man caught can expect their semen to be sucked up to the last drop. Even if caught as a prisoner of war, the captured prey is likely to be sucked to death.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
